text:
marc: FYI hit a subtle bug in the JS batching helper: it coerces mixed-length vectors to the shortest length when building the batch buffer. That silently corrupts embeddings before rerank.

anya: oof. can you share a tiny repro and helper version?

marc: using @redwood/sdk-js v1.5.0 Batcher. repro payload (simplified): inputs: [[...512 floats...], [...768 floats...]] -> client sent second vector trimmed to 512. Python SDK correctly errored.

anya: this was meant as a perf optimization for numeric arrays but is the wrong default for semantic vectors. short-term fix: change to throw on mixed lengths and include index in error. long-term: validate against model_dim from catalog.

marc: agreed. also suggest emitting telemetry 'embed.shape.mismatch' so we can find impacted apps and add a support playbook.

build-bot: created pr #678 for helper fail-fast and unit tests across Node/Py parity. CI queued.

support-bot: mark for #support sweep; prepare migration note for customers that relied on truncation and provide a small compatibility shim (pad_or_truncate: true) behind a config flag.

anya: i'll update the retriever example to include an early assertion: if (vec.length !== modelDim) throw new Error(...) so sample-apps catch this during onboarding.

marc: thanks. will keep thread pinned and paste network traces into the support doc once ci passes.

build-bot: CI passed for pr #678. Merging to next minor release.
